53e1cfaad5e0566e4ea1.page_headline: Ibero-American Summit advances regional disaster response, environmental coordination, and cooperation on AI and digital sovereignty.
53e1cfaad5e0566e4ea1.summary: Spain is preparing to host the 30th Ibero-American Summit in Madrid in November 2026. Regional initiatives cover AI, disaster response, environmental sustainability, care policy, academic mobility and cooperation planning from 2027, with new networks, charters, agendas and strategies.

3090da02f395b8809131.headline: Slovenia establishes an AI advisory council and designates authorities to implement the European Cyber Resilience Act.
3090da02f395b8809131.page_headline: Slovenia establishes an AI advisory council and designates authorities to implement the European Cyber Resilience Act.
3090da02f395b8809131.summary: The Government established a 48-member AI and Digitalisation Council, outlined deficit-management preparations for the 2027–2028 budgets, and approved a draft law on access to cash and payment services. It also adopted a burial-area decree and made several public-sector appointments.

2e8803a578995adb3b60.headline: Spain launches a campaign warning that AI-generated sexual deepfakes enable digital violence against women.
2e8803a578995adb3b60.page_headline: Spain launches a campaign warning that AI-generated sexual deepfakes enable digital violence against women.
2e8803a578995adb3b60.summary: Spain’s equality minister and gender-violence delegate presented a campaign warning that AI-generated sexual deepfakes are a form of gender-based digital violence. The campaign highlights the non-consensual use and rapid spread of women’s images, and calls for social awareness and responsibility.

45c2e6222fa2bcdee437.headline: Estonia’s prime minister urges unified European action on Ukraine and security, and stronger, safer European AI…
45c2e6222fa2bcdee437.page_headline: Estonia’s prime minister urges unified European action on Ukraine and security, and stronger, safer European AI capabilities.
45c2e6222fa2bcdee437.summary: Prime Minister Kristen Michal will attend European meetings in Ireland, advocating continued support for Ukraine, pressure on Russia, and a common EU position. Discussions will also address European AI capabilities, safe use, investment, energy, and funding Ukraine’s needs next year.

24fdfa2b534e112c3d66.headline: Moldova and the World Bank discuss AI applications and potential support for cyber resilience projects.
24fdfa2b534e112c3d66.page_headline: Moldova and the World Bank discuss AI applications and potential support for cyber resilience projects.
24fdfa2b534e112c3d66.summary: Prime Minister Vasile Tofan and World Bank regional director Michel Kerf discussed AI and other technologies to boost productivity, potential project financing, and opportunities to pilot innovations in Moldova. Kerf also expressed openness to considering support for cyber-resilience projects.

13446e75e78b5701a66c.headline: U.S. strategy targets resilient infrastructure, domestic energy and component supply, and secure digital systems.
13446e75e78b5701a66c.page_headline: U.S. strategy targets resilient infrastructure, domestic energy and component supply, and secure digital systems.
13446e75e78b5701a66c.summary: The message honors workers who build and protect U.S. infrastructure and outlines an America First resilience agenda: strengthen domestic supply chains and energy production, modernize infrastructure, expand AI data centers while protecting ratepayers, and improve readiness for crises.

6857c69aceb6a6926df6.headline: UK Prime Minister discusses AI risks, international standards and cooperation ahead of the UK’s 2027 G20…
6857c69aceb6a6926df6.page_headline: UK Prime Minister discusses AI risks, international standards and cooperation ahead of the UK’s 2027 G20 Presidency.
6857c69aceb6a6926df6.summary: The Prime Minister discussed AI cooperation with President Macron, highlighting AI’s potential benefits and risks, the UK’s expertise through its AI Security Institute, and plans to prioritise AI and international standards during the UK’s 2027 G20 Presidency.

7b902390cebc0f5d1039.headline: Estonia agenda includes drinking-water safeguards, critical-service resilience, Ukraine support, and border-security information cooperation.
7b902390cebc0f5d1039.page_headline: Estonia agenda includes drinking-water safeguards, critical-service resilience, Ukraine support, and border-security information cooperation.
7b902390cebc0f5d1039.summary: The Government agenda includes draft legislation on industrial emissions, repair rights, disability and parking cards, drinking water, permits, VAT, traffic rules and background checks, alongside AI codes, funding and reserve proposals, digital governance, EU housing objections and an EU–US information-sharing framework.

cf3d6323a26683635404.headline: Denmark’s prime minister calls for stronger European support for Ukraine amid Russian and hybrid attacks.
cf3d6323a26683635404.page_headline: Denmark’s prime minister calls for stronger European support for Ukraine amid Russian and hybrid attacks.
cf3d6323a26683635404.summary: Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen is travelling to Dublin for the ninth EPC meeting, where defence, security and hybrid threats are in focus. She will co-moderate a discussion on defending democratic Europe. Her Ireland visit also includes an informal European Council meeting focused on artificial intelligence.

a96a39fbd0e8d7c460b7.headline: Estonia’s agenda addresses fuel-price pressures on public transport, AI accountability, healthcare AI, and youth nicotine risks.
a96a39fbd0e8d7c460b7.page_headline: Estonia’s agenda addresses fuel-price pressures on public transport, AI accountability, healthcare AI, and youth nicotine risks.
a96a39fbd0e8d7c460b7.summary: The Cabinet agenda covers fuel-price impacts on public transport, Estonia–US memorandum negotiations, support for Estonian candidates for senior international roles, AI agent codes and healthcare, electricity-price support for large consumers, tobacco legislation, and use of earmarked Government reserve funds.

d1c9f78c8bfc011634f1.headline: Andorra Business awards €1 million to company R&D projects, including work on antibiotic resistance, water monitoring…
d1c9f78c8bfc011634f1.page_headline: Andorra Business awards €1 million to company R&D projects, including work on antibiotic resistance, water monitoring and infrastructure inspection.
d1c9f78c8bfc011634f1.summary: Andorra Business awarded €1 million to 10 of 30 applicant local R&D projects across sectors including health, construction, water monitoring, sports technology, drones, retail analytics, language AI and cosmetics, supporting skilled jobs and products and services for wider markets.

da239373635d2d24ab50.headline: Moldova reports a cyberattack on government infrastructure and plans secure data infrastructure to strengthen digital resilience.
da239373635d2d24ab50.page_headline: Moldova reports a cyberattack on government infrastructure and plans secure data infrastructure to strengthen digital resilience.
da239373635d2d24ab50.summary: Moldova hosted the first Digital Connectivity Platform meeting, where leaders discussed secure digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI and regional cooperation. Announced initiatives include EU-funded Wi-Fi access in at least 30 localities and preparation of a secure, resilient data centre project.

a43e7da9674e581e716f.headline: Czech government proposes energy-price intervention powers, drone protections for critical infrastructure, and an AI council.
a43e7da9674e581e716f.page_headline: Czech government proposes energy-price intervention powers, drone protections for critical infrastructure, and an AI council.
a43e7da9674e581e716f.summary: The Czech Government approved a CZK 68.62 billion healthcare investment plan for 2028–2034, established an AI council and approved the Prime Minister’s mandate for an informal EU leaders’ meeting in Dublin. It also discussed energy, legal, infrastructure, healthcare digitalisation, agricultural subsidies and audit findings.

b871dc3f647afa076b94.headline: Estonia pledges €6.5 million in support for Ukraine as leaders discuss war, European security, and AI…
b871dc3f647afa076b94.page_headline: Estonia pledges €6.5 million in support for Ukraine as leaders discuss war, European security, and AI dependence.
b871dc3f647afa076b94.summary: At the Dublin European Council meeting, Estonia’s Prime Minister urged leaders to focus on supporting Ukraine rather than discussing changes to Europe’s security arrangements, and announced €6.5 million in additional aid. Leaders also discussed strengthening Europe’s AI sector, investment and oversight of powerful models.

2e9209c789b945feca67.headline: Andorra Research Week includes sessions on preventing and anticipating natural hazards.
2e9209c789b945feca67.page_headline: Andorra Research Week includes sessions on preventing and anticipating natural hazards.
2e9209c789b945feca67.summary: Andorra’s 2nd Research Week, held from 16 to 21 November, features sixteen activities organised with ten institutions. Its programme covers natural hazards, AI, health, public policy and biodiversity through debates, workshops, lectures and field activities.

d62cd63cbf144b067375.headline: Ibero-American countries agree to develop sovereign, regionally adapted AI and coordinate on data, computing and digital…
d62cd63cbf144b067375.page_headline: Ibero-American countries agree to develop sovereign, regionally adapted AI and coordinate on data, computing and digital safeguards.
d62cd63cbf144b067375.summary: Ibero-American ministers agreed in Madrid to establish a voluntary AI Alliance focused on data cooperation, regionally relevant models and computing access, while advancing the digital rights charter and discussing digital rights, child protection, connectivity, cybersecurity and digital government.

77e1a6b9b6b09a89c95d.headline: Ibero-American forum promotes sovereign AI and digital capacity while addressing cybersecurity and digital rights.
77e1a6b9b6b09a89c95d.page_headline: Ibero-American forum promotes sovereign AI and digital capacity while addressing cybersecurity and digital rights.
77e1a6b9b6b09a89c95d.summary: Spain’s digital transformation minister opened the Ibero-American Digital Forum in Madrid. Participants discussed digital rights, cybersecurity, connectivity, digital government and AI, emphasizing regional cooperation and sovereign, ethical, trustworthy AI rooted in Ibero-American languages, data and priorities.

fb977480d066a57c4091.headline: Iceland funds expanded online-safety education and prevention for children, including responses to AI-related challenges.
fb977480d066a57c4091.page_headline: Iceland funds expanded online-safety education and prevention for children, including responses to AI-related challenges.
fb977480d066a57c4091.summary: Iceland’s Ministry of Culture, Innovation and Higher Education will support Netvís for three years, providing an additional ISK 20 million annually alongside EU funding to expand education and prevention on AI and media literacy, online safety, and risks affecting children and young people.

80f6f5ac212fb70d7d3e.headline: Andorra hosts Council of Europe conference on AI, democratic education and intercultural dialogue globally.
80f6f5ac212fb70d7d3e.page_headline: Andorra hosts Council of Europe conference on AI, democratic education and intercultural dialogue globally.
80f6f5ac212fb70d7d3e.summary: Andorra will host the Council of Europe's North-South Centre conference on intercultural dialogue and AI, focusing on education for democratic, inclusive digital societies. The event will foster dialogue among Europe, Africa, and the Middle East, addressing AI's opportunities, challenges, and governance in a human rights…
body_paragraphs: Andorra will host the Council of Europe's North-South Centre conference on intercultural dialogue and AI, focusing on education for democratic, inclusive digital societies. The event will foster dialogue among Europe, Africa, and the Middle East, addressing AI's opportunities, challenges, and governance in a human rights framework.

8c43b9854041da796641.headline: Andorra calls for multilateral conflict prevention and international cooperation on AI-driven influence content and hate speech.
8c43b9854041da796641.page_headline: Andorra calls for multilateral conflict prevention and international cooperation on AI-driven influence content and hate speech.
8c43b9854041da796641.summary: Andorra’s foreign minister attended the Francophonie ministerial conference in Phnom Penh, advocating multilingualism, peace and AI cooperation and meeting Senegalese and Kosovan counterparts. Head of Government Xavier Espot will represent Andorra at the summit, which is expected to adopt declarations on cooperation, crises and peacebuilding.

2a8e7651f908d61757c8.headline: UK and Azerbaijan add AI expertise exchange to their strategic partnership.
2a8e7651f908d61757c8.page_headline: UK and Azerbaijan add AI expertise exchange to their strategic partnership.
2a8e7651f908d61757c8.summary: The UK and Azerbaijan agreed to exchange expertise on AI, digital governance and innovation under a new strategic partnership. The declaration also covers security, trade, energy and regional peace.

b1f70657a865d02bf9c2.headline: Kazakhstan says AI and space monitoring will help forecast natural hazards and prevent emergencies.
b1f70657a865d02bf9c2.page_headline: Kazakhstan says AI and space monitoring will help forecast natural hazards and prevent emergencies.
b1f70657a865d02bf9c2.summary: At COP31, Kazakhstan said it is introducing AI and space monitoring to forecast natural hazards and prevent emergencies. Prime Minister Bektenov also presented climate and energy projects and international cooperation proposals.

5f4fb3551ad7e6c5b6b6.headline: Estonian youth council flags AI misuse and online scams while weighing moderate social-media limits.
5f4fb3551ad7e6c5b6b6.page_headline: Estonian youth council flags AI misuse and online scams while weighing moderate social-media limits.
5f4fb3551ad7e6c5b6b6.summary: Estonia’s youth council says students favor moderate social-media limits. Workshops identified AI misuse, misinformation and online scams among digital risks; the council will publish recommendations in December.

278e70e88147bb2c9b11.headline: Luxembourg discusses AI’s effects on banking and financial resilience at Eurogroup.
278e70e88147bb2c9b11.page_headline: Luxembourg discusses AI’s effects on banking and financial resilience at Eurogroup.
278e70e88147bb2c9b11.summary: At Eurogroup and ECOFIN meetings, Luxembourg’s finance minister discussed AI’s effects on banking and ways to strengthen financial resilience. Ministers also considered European security, Ukraine and EU legislation.

b1b34cf07234fcc1fe5a.headline: Kazakhstan plans copper foil for AI server boards at an $810 million plant.
b1b34cf07234fcc1fe5a.page_headline: Kazakhstan plans copper foil for AI server boards at an $810 million plant.
b1b34cf07234fcc1fe5a.summary: Kazakhstan announced an $810 million copper-foil plant planned to make material for batteries and circuit boards used in AI servers and data centres. Production is expected to begin in 2029.

bfff253c6ae5b985b479.headline: Dutch government sets AI strategy to strengthen access and capability while addressing cyber, disinformation, and dependency…
bfff253c6ae5b985b479.page_headline: Dutch government sets AI strategy to strengthen access and capability while addressing cyber, disinformation, and dependency risks.
bfff253c6ae5b985b479.summary: The Dutch government approved a national AI vision focused on responsible adoption, access to advanced technology and security, and safeguarding public values. It plans to support AI businesses and infrastructure, reduce dependence and risks, help organizations apply EU rules, and involve citizens in 2027–2028.

6b81efe72d632959d31f.headline: Kazakhstan advances a large data-centre project, including new energy infrastructure and expanded AI computing capacity.
6b81efe72d632959d31f.page_headline: Kazakhstan advances a large data-centre project, including new energy infrastructure and expanded AI computing capacity.
6b81efe72d632959d31f.summary: Prime Minister Bektenov reviewed Pavlodar's Data Processing Centers Valley, including a 164 MW Firebird AI data centre under construction. Its first phase totals 304 MW across three centres. Officials were told to expand computing and power infrastructure and meet commissioning deadlines.

09fa9f199791dc447452.headline: Bulgaria plans its first AI gigafactory alongside increased science funding.
09fa9f199791dc447452.page_headline: Bulgaria plans its first AI gigafactory alongside increased science funding.
09fa9f199791dc447452.summary: Prime Minister Rumen Radev presented the 2027 budget, highlighting a nearly 100% increase in science funding and initiatives in AI, robotics, energy, space and connectivity. He said the measures aim to modernise Bulgaria’s economy, encourage domestic investment and attract strategic foreign investors.

ed9190ea3dd4e848af6b.headline: Kazakhstan advances grid upgrades, generation projects, and AI-based controls to improve electricity reliability and energy independence.
ed9190ea3dd4e848af6b.page_headline: Kazakhstan advances grid upgrades, generation projects, and AI-based controls to improve electricity reliability and energy independence.
ed9190ea3dd4e848af6b.summary: Prime Minister Olzhas Bektenov reviewed grid and generation projects, energy-system preparations, and digital modernization. He instructed officials to update the national energy balance by September next year and strengthen oversight of investment-project schedules. KEGOC reported efficiency gains from AI, automation, and synchrophasor systems.

b7253d5b8a98f9276516.headline: Andorra backs a new Ibero-American AI alliance alongside disaster-risk cooperation.
b7253d5b8a98f9276516.page_headline: Andorra backs a new Ibero-American AI alliance alongside disaster-risk cooperation.
b7253d5b8a98f9276516.summary: At the Ibero-American Summit, Andorra highlighted the launch of a regional AI alliance alongside disaster-risk cooperation, digital equity and support for Ukraine. It will chair the disaster-risk network in 2027.

de4fecfbf8ab7ea67b73.headline: Kosovo’s prime minister highlights AI opportunities and says its use must respect rights, privacy, and data…
de4fecfbf8ab7ea67b73.page_headline: Kosovo’s prime minister highlights AI opportunities and says its use must respect rights, privacy, and data security.
de4fecfbf8ab7ea67b73.summary: At DOKU.TECH 2026, Prime Minister Albin Kurti highlighted Kosovo’s growing ICT sector and digital services, urging responsible AI, investment in skills, locally developed high-value technology, and cooperation among institutions, businesses, universities, and the diaspora to create opportunities for young people.

5500ca7c86470004e3a9.headline: Icelandic government teams will use OpenAI’s cybersecurity model to find vulnerabilities and strengthen public digital services.
5500ca7c86470004e3a9.page_headline: Icelandic government teams will use OpenAI’s cybersecurity model to find vulnerabilities and strengthen public digital services.
5500ca7c86470004e3a9.summary: Umbra and CERT-IS have received assessed access to OpenAI’s cybersecurity model through GTAC. They will explore its use for defensive tasks under specialist oversight, strict security requirements, and authorization limits.

4b50327151948d74ac97.headline: Croatia plans criminal-law updates targeting online abuse, AI-generated sexual deepfakes and emerging technology risks.
4b50327151948d74ac97.page_headline: Croatia plans criminal-law updates targeting online abuse, AI-generated sexual deepfakes and emerging technology risks.
4b50327151948d74ac97.summary: Croatia's Justice Minister proposed Criminal Code changes addressing online harassment and the non-consensual sharing of sexual deepfakes created with AI. The wider package also covers cyberstalking, explicit-image sharing and a separate law to protect minors online.

eecb217c1d39da14296b.headline: Germany’s National Security Council reviews defence expansion, space security, crisis response, AI safety and intelligence rules.
eecb217c1d39da14296b.page_headline: Germany’s National Security Council reviews defence expansion, space security, crisis response, AI safety and intelligence rules.
eecb217c1d39da14296b.summary: The National Security Council discussed NATO planning, Bundeswehr expansion, space security, crisis-response capacity and AI safety, intelligence-law rules, and recent violent disturbances. It agreed to strengthen space security through research and development, review post-service activity rules, and thanked emergency responders.

a8697cc879473202c61b.headline: Andorra’s foreign minister calls for human-centred AI, citing risks of disinformation, manipulation, discrimination, and unequal access.
a8697cc879473202c61b.page_headline: Andorra’s foreign minister calls for human-centred AI, citing risks of disinformation, manipulation, discrimination, and unequal access.
a8697cc879473202c61b.summary: Andorra’s foreign affairs minister opened a Council of Europe conference on intercultural dialogue, education and inclusive AI. Speakers highlighted AI’s opportunities and risks, unequal access, and education’s role in fostering critical, responsible use grounded in human rights and democratic values.

8c86ef7bdfce5d86b178.headline: Greek cabinet considers labour-market AI rules and platform-worker protections.
8c86ef7bdfce5d86b178.page_headline: Greek cabinet considers labour-market AI rules and platform-worker protections.
8c86ef7bdfce5d86b178.summary: Greece’s cabinet considered a bill setting rules for AI use in the labour market and protections for platform workers. It also reviewed defence, policing, emergency-service and investment measures.

62347da91db6a9358ce8.headline: Croatia’s prime minister warns AI manipulation could threaten democracy and rights.
62347da91db6a9358ce8.page_headline: Croatia’s prime minister warns AI manipulation could threaten democracy and rights.
62347da91db6a9358ce8.summary: At the World Forum for Democracy, Croatia’s prime minister warned that AI can aid innovation but, without safeguards, can enable manipulation and threaten human rights. He also discussed Ukraine and democratic security.

5abd7ccdc15dc716ae13.headline: Luxembourg highlights an AI platform for biodiversity and climate finance.
5abd7ccdc15dc716ae13.page_headline: Luxembourg highlights an AI platform for biodiversity and climate finance.
5abd7ccdc15dc716ae13.summary: At COP17, Luxembourg promoted biodiversity finance, including an AI-based platform designed to attract capital to projects benefiting climate, biodiversity and communities. Delegates also reviewed lagging progress toward 2030 nature goals.

19970664ea8e6f384e43.headline: Netherlands considers EU rules for child safety on social media and AI chatbots.
19970664ea8e6f384e43.page_headline: Netherlands considers EU rules for child safety on social media and AI chatbots.
19970664ea8e6f384e43.summary: The Dutch government supports the EU Kids Act’s safety rules for social media, games and AI chatbots, while seeking closer scrutiny of children’s rights, privacy and reliance on parental monitoring.

b2ef7fd09c67c3755618.headline: Georgia calls for AI oversight in Black Sea maritime security.
b2ef7fd09c67c3755618.page_headline: Georgia calls for AI oversight in Black Sea maritime security.
b2ef7fd09c67c3755618.summary: At a UN Security Council debate, Deputy Foreign Minister Totladze linked AI, modern monitoring and unmanned technologies to maritime security. She urged safeguards, oversight and accountability while citing threats from Russia's occupation of Georgian regions and war against Ukraine.

72c62b6823ffc4436905.headline: WHO selects Luxembourg to host a regional office supporting safe and trustworthy AI in health.
72c62b6823ffc4436905.page_headline: WHO selects Luxembourg to host a regional office supporting safe and trustworthy AI in health.
72c62b6823ffc4436905.summary: WHO’s Regional Committee for Europe selected Luxembourg to host a geographically dispersed office focused on AI in health. The office will support Member States in adopting safe, ethical and trustworthy AI, complement Luxembourg’s national initiatives, and foster training, research and international cooperation.

57894328f9454651c87f.headline: Malta outlines business, AI and industrial initiatives, including solar panels and energy efficiency in industrial areas.
57894328f9454651c87f.page_headline: Malta outlines business, AI and industrial initiatives, including solar panels and energy efficiency in industrial areas.
57894328f9454651c87f.summary: Minister Silvio Schembri outlined ten initiatives aligned with Malta Vision 2050, including tax relief for small firms, funding for digitalisation and AI, business support, bureaucracy reduction, investment in innovative sectors, an industrial policy, and a study of possible land reclamation near the Freeport.

03f1c1d34f736656216a.headline: Luxembourg calls for patient-centred health AI at WHO Europe meeting.
03f1c1d34f736656216a.page_headline: Luxembourg calls for patient-centred health AI at WHO Europe meeting.
03f1c1d34f736656216a.summary: Minister Martine Deprez attended the WHO European Regional Committee’s 76th session in Copenhagen. Luxembourg highlighted the need for international cooperation, clear WHO priorities, preserved expertise and sustainable workloads, less fragmented global health governance, responsible health AI, and stronger primary health care.

1f54f33f92f0bd0fe08b.headline: Estonia outlines positions on communications infrastructure, European cloud and AI security, data protection, and Europol cooperation.
1f54f33f92f0bd0fe08b.page_headline: Estonia outlines positions on communications infrastructure, European cloud and AI security, data protection, and Europol cooperation.
1f54f33f92f0bd0fe08b.summary: Estonia's cabinet agenda sets out its position on EU cloud and AI regulation: expand European computing capacity, define public-cloud trust levels, strengthen critical-sector security and reduce reliance on providers outside the EU. The agenda also covers domestic and foreign policy.

198c6cf02c330deca207.headline: Switzerland advances AI regulation and industry guidance, including measures addressing risks to electricity supply.
198c6cf02c330deca207.page_headline: Switzerland advances AI regulation and industry guidance, including measures addressing risks to electricity supply.
198c6cf02c330deca207.summary: The Federal Council reviewed progress implementing the Council of Europe AI Convention, including federal-sector measures and voluntary AI-code guidance. It tasked OFCOM with coordinating further work through March 2028. Legally binding measures covering transparency, data protection, non-discrimination, oversight and risk assessment are planned for consultation…
body_paragraphs: The Federal Council reviewed progress implementing the Council of Europe AI Convention, including federal-sector measures and voluntary AI-code guidance. It tasked OFCOM with coordinating further work through March 2028. Legally binding measures covering transparency, data protection, non-discrimination, oversight and risk assessment are planned for consultation in spring 2027.

e6b2633a1a881dafde66.headline: Austria proposes privacy rules for AI-enabled smart glasses and covert recording.
e6b2633a1a881dafde66.page_headline: Austria proposes privacy rules for AI-enabled smart glasses and covert recording.
e6b2633a1a881dafde66.summary: Austria proposed tiered privacy rules for smart glasses with cameras, microphones and AI functions. The plan would bar use in sensitive places and require visible recording indicators in public.

4903511d02b5bfbbb5a8.headline: Nordic leaders discuss children’s safety amid social media, smart devices and AI.
4903511d02b5bfbbb5a8.page_headline: Nordic leaders discuss children’s safety amid social media, smart devices and AI.
4903511d02b5bfbbb5a8.summary: Nordic prime ministers agreed to protect children amid social media, smart devices and AI, discussing age limits and phone-free schools. They also addressed regional security and Nordic cooperation.

6fb4ad90738712d3ecac.headline: Netherlands backs AI-guided therapies and robotics in MedTech 2035 plan.
6fb4ad90738712d3ecac.page_headline: Netherlands backs AI-guided therapies and robotics in MedTech 2035 plan.
6fb4ad90738712d3ecac.summary: The Netherlands aims to become Europe's leading medical technology sector by 2035 through a €102.5 million government and €200 million private-public investment. The MedTech 2035 policy focuses on AI, robotics, and collaboration to advance healthcare innovation, economic growth, and system resilience.

54269fa4c02e5e9f259d.headline: Croatia invests in AI, lifelong learning, and competitiveness to adapt labor market amid global disruptions.
54269fa4c02e5e9f259d.page_headline: Croatia invests in AI, lifelong learning, and competitiveness to adapt labor market amid global disruptions.
54269fa4c02e5e9f259d.summary: Prime Minister Plenković highlighted challenges due to the EU's complex relations with China, Russia, and the USA, affecting competitiveness and labor markets. Croatia is experiencing solid growth and aims to invest in economic competitiveness, AI, and skill development while maintaining social cohesion and fiscal responsibility.…
body_paragraphs: Prime Minister Plenković highlighted challenges due to the EU's complex relations with China, Russia, and the USA, affecting competitiveness and labor markets. Croatia is experiencing solid growth and aims to invest in economic competitiveness, AI, and skill development while maintaining social cohesion and fiscal responsibility. Emphasis is on lifelong learning, green transition, and export-oriented industry to adapt to global changes and technological advancements.

7b92f5eb993c070eca4b.headline: UK and Oman agree to deepen AI and critical-technology cooperation.
7b92f5eb993c070eca4b.page_headline: UK and Oman agree to deepen AI and critical-technology cooperation.
7b92f5eb993c070eca4b.summary: The UK and Oman agreed to deepen cooperation on AI, data centres, critical minerals and space through exchanges and technical meetings. Their wider partnership also covers defence, green industries and regional stability.

066566daa57489d292a6.headline: Germany supports GAMI to protect digital historical archives from AI falsifications and combat disinformation.
066566daa57489d292a6.page_headline: Germany supports GAMI to protect digital historical archives from AI falsifications and combat disinformation.
066566daa57489d292a6.summary: The German government and Google.org support the Global Authentic Memory Initiative (GAMI) to protect historical digital archives from AI-generated falsifications. Through cryptographic verification, GAMI ensures document authenticity, combating disinformation and preserving trust in historical records for future generations.

8fddb8a43c6f356dcea1.headline: Sweden joins EU AI gigafactory initiative to boost digital independence, competitiveness, and computing power.
8fddb8a43c6f356dcea1.page_headline: Sweden joins EU AI gigafactory initiative to boost digital independence, competitiveness, and computing power.
8fddb8a43c6f356dcea1.summary: Sweden's government authorized the Tax Agency to join a EuroHPC agreement to establish EU AI gigafactories. This cooperation with Finland aims to enhance Sweden's and the EU's digital sovereignty by providing access to advanced computing power for public sector and research use.

82d62b02e8ecd4308de5.headline: Malta’s Identità Agency plans AI and digitalisation investments to improve identity services securely by 2032.
82d62b02e8ecd4308de5.page_headline: Malta’s Identità Agency plans AI and digitalisation investments to improve identity services securely by 2032.
82d62b02e8ecd4308de5.summary: Minister Jonathan Attard chaired a meeting with civil society to discuss Identità Agency's 2027-2032 strategy, focusing on digitalisation, AI, efficiency, and security. Stakeholders shared input to enhance services, reduce bureaucracy, and safeguard identity and data protection in the Agency’s future plans.

b39eb1f211967b4c71a1.headline: Bulgaria deepens AI and digital infrastructure partnership with Google, enhancing security and economic competitiveness.

da9a13881f5f30e39280.summary: Luxembourg’s SMC marked 50 years of press aid with a conference on media pluralism and digital-age challenges. Speakers discussed funding, AI, independent journalism and fair relations between media and platforms, stressing the need to balance innovation, media viability and pluralism.

b6ab6a865c7727dcab36.page_headline: Nordic and Baltic ministers seek digital sovereignty; Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania are invited to the New Nordics AI cooperation platform.
b6ab6a865c7727dcab36.summary: Nordic and Baltic ministers adopted a declaration to strengthen regional digital sovereignty by 2030, including through cooperation on cloud procurement, submarine-cable security and shared infrastructure projects. Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania were invited to join the New Nordics AI platform.

591f259c4d3bff29412e.headline: Trump discusses air-traffic-control upgrades, superintelligence, China and Russia, and alleges Iran may be considering biological weapons.
591f259c4d3bff29412e.page_headline: Trump discusses air-traffic-control upgrades, superintelligence, China and Russia, and alleges Iran may be considering biological weapons.
591f259c4d3bff29412e.summary: The White House recaps President Trump’s Fox News interview from Shenzhen, covering U.S.–China relations, air-traffic-control modernization, technology outages, Iran, cooperation with Democrats, Super Intelligence, and claims that Obama brought Russia and China closer.

7480232694c7eb45e52b.page_headline: Estonia urges European AI investment to compete with the US and China, alongside wider AI training.
7480232694c7eb45e52b.summary: Estonia called for European AI investment to avoid falling behind the United States and China, alongside AI skills training. Ministers also backed restrictions on Russian and Belarusian participation in international sport during Russia’s war against Ukraine.

c1f59b47edf050ee1ea4.headline: Canada and the UK renew AI security cooperation on risk-sharing, standards, evaluations and societal resilience.
c1f59b47edf050ee1ea4.page_headline: Canada and the UK renew AI security cooperation on risk-sharing, standards, evaluations and societal resilience.
c1f59b47edf050ee1ea4.summary: Canada and the United Kingdom renewed their AI security partnership, prioritizing shared standards, sensitive information-sharing, societal resilience, and technical cooperation, including exchanges and coordinated evaluations. The agreement builds on earlier bilateral initiatives and cooperation between their AI safety and security institutes.

be98b1f35db3d183d0ce.headline: Canada expands AI funding to strengthen domestic computing capacity and support Canadian companies.
be98b1f35db3d183d0ce.page_headline: Canada expands AI funding to strengthen domestic computing capacity and support Canadian companies.
be98b1f35db3d183d0ce.summary: Canada is increasing the AI Compute Access Fund by $700 million to $1 billion, prioritizing Canadian-owned computing capacity and launching a health and life sciences proposal call; more than $52 million has been allocated to 45 companies.

8f816493f4126f65ad83.headline: Canada details May awards to 44 AI companies, including cybersecurity and wildfire-detection projects.
8f816493f4126f65ad83.page_headline: Canada details May awards to 44 AI companies, including cybersecurity and wildfire-detection projects.
8f816493f4126f65ad83.summary: Canada’s backgrounder lists 44 companies awarded $66 million on 12 May 2026 through the AI Compute Access Fund. Projects include AI for cybersecurity, wildfire monitoring and agriculture, supported by access to computing resources for Canadian AI development.

7a75e8b457aad440fea1.page_headline: Canada expands AI compute funding for SMEs, supporting domestic AI capacity and projects in cybersecurity, energy, food and health.
7a75e8b457aad440fea1.summary: Canada’s backgrounder details more than $52 million for 45 AI Compute Access Fund recipients announced on 26 November. Projects cover applications including cybersecurity, energy and health, using computing support to develop and scale Canadian AI.
